items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: there was a fellow by the name of Sam Peet, who had a ballroom right on the corner.

ctx.x: Did you follow the wolves as a child, as a kid?

No, I would just see them marching. But see, now, when I moved on this side of the river and I went into the service, I lost contact with the wolves organization. Not that I was a member or anything, but my father knew a lot of the people who were members of the wolves, because from time to time, some of the members would come to his barbershop. See, my father being a barber, well, he had a barbershop on Wire Street in Gretchen. And a lot of times, and see, the reason why a lot of people would come to the…
Yeah, but the barbershops in general tend to attract people who aren't doing anything.
